## Release dates (checked 2026-10-21)

- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy_XV:_A_New_Empire (text pasted by user): infobox developer Epic Action, publisher MZ, Android, iOS and iPadOS, release June 29, 2017, strategy, multiplayer; the article text (read by me through the API) says "released worldwide on June 28, 2017"
- https://breezewiki.com/finalfantasy/wiki/Final_Fantasy_XV:_A_New_Empire (text pasted by user): release dates NZ March 31, 2017 and WW June 28, 2017; the Japanese title is ファイナルファンタジーXV：新たなる王国 (Fainaru Fantajī Fifutīn: Ara tanaru Ōkoku)
  - The NZ date comes from Gematsu, 2017-03-31 (published 3:21 PM EDT): "is available now via the App Store in New Zealand" (https://gematsu.com/2017/03/machine-zone-final-fantasy-xv-mobile-game-revealed-final-fantasy-xv-new-empire, Wayback https://web.archive.org/web/20191216154542/https://gematsu.com/2017/03/machine-zone-final-fantasy-xv-mobile-game-revealed-final-fantasy-xv-new-empire; read by me): a New Zealand iOS soft launch, the first public availability, reported that day; the official site's 2024 App Store link is the /nz/ one (apps.apple.com/nz/app/final-fantasy-xv-a-new-empire/id1186994231)
  - The entry keeps the worldwide date 2017-06-29 (the Wikipedia infobox); Wikipedia's text and the Final Fantasy Wiki say June 28 (the Verge's release article is dated 2017-06-28; a time-zone difference is likely); a Candidate is logged in docs/wiki-corrections.md
